personal.title: Cloud & Backend Engineer
personal.summary: Motivated and detail-oriented Computer Science student with hands-on experience in cloud-native application development using AWS. Proficient in building serverless architectures with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB. Passionate about Infrastructure as Code, automation, and designing scalable, cost-efficient backend systems. Seeking opportunities to apply practical cloud engineering skills in a professional environment.

experience.title: Cloud Engineering Intern
responsibilities: Developed and deployed serverless REST APIs using AWS Lambda and API Gateway.
Designed and managed DynamoDB tables with optimized partition and sort key strategies.
Authored AWS SAM templates for repeatable, automated infrastructure deployments.
Monitored Lambda execution and API latency using Amazon CloudWatch.
Participated in daily stand-ups and sprint planning in an Agile team environment.
achievements: Reduced average API response time by 30% by optimizing DynamoDB Query patterns.
Automated infrastructure provisioning for three microservices using AWS SAM and CloudFormation.
Received positive feedback from the engineering lead for clean, well-documented code.

experience.title: Student Project Lead – Cloud Systems
responsibilities: Led a team of four students to design and build a serverless document management system on AWS.
Coordinated task distribution and code reviews using GitHub and Git branching workflows.
Integrated AWS IAM roles and policies following the principle of least privilege.
Presented project architecture and results to faculty evaluators and industry guests.
achievements: Project awarded Best Technical Implementation at the department-level project exhibition.
Successfully deployed the system to AWS with zero manual configuration steps.
Documented the entire architecture and deployment process for future student cohorts.

academic_achievements: Consistently maintained above-average academic performance throughout the program.
Active member of the College Cloud Computing Club.
Completed AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials training (AWS Skill Builder).
